storage.format: Newline-separated known place slugs; duplicates and unknown entries are discarded.
storage.mark: When a destination document loads or is restored from history; previews do not mark visits.
storage.reset: Remove only the named key. No storage.clear operation.
storage.failure: Nonfatal; page discloses that a visit could not be saved.

interaction.desktop: Hover or focus a numbered native link to preview; click or Enter opens its page. Escape dismisses its preview.
interaction.mobile: At up to 760 CSS pixels, tap previews in a panel below the scrollable map; a separate Explore link opens the place. Media-query changes rebind this behaviour.
interaction.fallback: All native map and list links continue to navigate without JavaScript.
interaction.motion: Two finite 2.5-second halo cycles, plus hover/focus transitions. Reduced-motion rules disable both.
